name: MSU Gas Pipeline
source: Morris ICS datasets, Dataset 2 (ORNL formatted ModbusRTUfeatureSetsV2.zip); Beaver et al. ICMLA 2013

name: MSU New Gas Pipeline 2015
notes: Integrated. Timestamped, interleaved attacks, no single-feature shortcut; see docs/benchmarks/gas2015_context_report.md.

name: MSU Water Storage
notes: Not integrated. The author warns these files contain unintended patterns that make attacks trivially separable.

name: OTRF Security-Datasets (Windows)

name: EVTX-to-MITRE-Attack (Windows)
